content: For a GitHub Pages *project* site (username.github.io/reponame/), Vite's vite.config.ts must set base: '/reponame/'. If using react-router, BrowserRouter must also receive basename='/reponame/' (or use HashRouter to avoid the need entirely). GitHub Pages doesn't support SPA history-mode routing natively (unknown deep links 404), commonly worked around with a 404.html that redirects to index.html (spa-github-pages trick) or by using HashRouter.
